items.markdown:
![Islands List for Island Hopping Krabi - Chase for Adventure](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262131-1672-0139-0000-864734ec7734:4)
`Krabi is not an island` , but rather a large province on the mainland of southern Thailand, located along the Andaman Sea. It serves as a major base for travel and is famous for being surrounded by over 150 spectacular offshore islands, including the popular **Koh Phi Phi** and **Koh Lanta**.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowTopic-g1499981-i14481-k4964070-Is_Krabi_an_island-Krabi_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowTopic-g1499981-i14481-k4964070-Is_Krabi_an_island-Krabi_Province.html)[[2]](https://thebackpackinghousewife.com/thailand-krabi/)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krabi_province)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CcHTogaV6Po&t=24)[[5]](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Tourism-g297927-Krabi_Town_Krabi_Province-Vacations.html)

While Krabi Town and the bustling tourist strip of **Ao Nang** are on the mainland, their geography of dramatic limestone cliffs means some famous coastal areas (like **Railay Beach** ) can only be reached by boat, making them feel like remote islands.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dx-WzdYddjs&vl=en&t=12) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dx-WzdYddjs&vl=en&t=12)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Krabi)[[3]](https://thailandstartshere.com/krabi-travel-guide/)

Because the area is heavily defined by its coastline, most visitors treat it as an island-hopping hub. If you are planning a trip, you can use the [Tourism Authority of Thailand](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Krabi/344) to get a comprehensive overview of the region's top mainland and offshore attractions.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Krabi/344) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Krabi/344)[[2]](https://www.traveloka.com/th-th/explore/destination/krabi-at-least-once-in-your-life/141504)[[3]](https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/krabi-ttd2174/fun-things-to-do-in-krabi/)

expanded_element.title: Krabi - Wikipedia
expanded_element.description: Krabi (Thai: กระบี่ , pronounced [krā. bìː] ) is the capital of and main town in Krabi Province (thesaban mueang), on the west coast of southern Thailand, where the Krabi River flows into Phang Nga Bay. The town lies 650 km (400 mi) south of Bangkok, and as of 2020, has a population of 32,644.

items.title: What is frowned upon in Thailand?

expanded_element.title: Do & Don't in Thailand | How to Act in Thailand
expanded_element.description: It is considered rude to use your feet for anything, as such do not point anything out with your feet, nudge anything with them, or even hold a door open with your feet. If you visit a temple do not sit with your feet towards the Buddha, instead sit with them crossed or with them tucked behind you.
